ext.description: Answer one question: if I change what I have open, what will I have to fix, and in what order? An ordered list, derived from a doctrine-governed document tree.
cmd.revealActive: Show what the open document changes
cmd.openForRange: Open the document for this range
cmd.revealById: Show what a document changes, by id
cmd.selectFolder: Choose which doctrine tree to show
cfg.pythonPath: The python executable that runs the doctrine CLI. Defaults to `python3`.
cfg.docsRoot: Path to the doctrine tree, relative to the workspace folder. Empty means look for `doctrine_docs/` first, then a `docs/` that has `_system/`.
cfg.pluginPath: Path to the doctrine plugin. Empty means resolve it from the install ledger and cache.
cfg.timeoutMs: Upper bound on one CLI call, in milliseconds.
cfg.autoRefresh: Refresh when a governed `.md` or a marked source file is saved.
cfg.auditDebounceMs: How long to wait after a change before running the full audit that decides fingerprint mismatches, in milliseconds. `0` runs it only on an explicit refresh.
cap.untrusted: Doctrine Lens runs the doctrine CLI with the configured Python interpreter, so it only works in a trusted folder.
cap.virtual: Doctrine Lens runs a local Python CLI against files on disk, so it needs a real filesystem.
